name: Emdash

runner.notes: Install the Emdash desktop app (macOS brew cask / dmg, Windows msi/exe, Linux AppImage/deb) or build from source, authenticate at least one guest coding CLI outside Emdash, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as a project, create a task with prompt.md on an isolated Git worktree, review diff/PR, then harness-verify. Record Emdash version, guest provider, local vs SSH remote, and interventions.

inclusion: Direct Class A open-source multi-agent ADE: YC W26 desktop control plane for parallel coding agents in Git worktrees, issue-to-agent intake, in-app browser, diff/PR/CI review, automations, and SSH remote projects.
pricing_model: Free and open source (Apache-2.0). Users bring existing coding-agent CLI subscriptions and keys. No Emdash model plan on reviewed pages.
public_stack_signals: Official site: open-source agentic development environment; multi-OS desktop; parallel agents; YC W26.
Public monorepo generalaction/emdash; Apache-2.0; pnpm/Nx TypeScript monorepo with Electron in build deps (package.json).
Local-first: app state in local SQLite; code/chats not sent to Emdash servers (README privacy claim).
Git worktree isolation per task; review diffs, open PRs, inspect CI from one place.
Supports many provider CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Amp, and more) with auto-detection and lifecycle hooks.
capabilities_to_probe: parallel agents each on its own Git worktree and branch
provider breadth and auto-detection of installed CLIs
issue/ticket intake from Linear, GitHub, Jira, GitLab, Asana, and others
diff review, commit, push, PR creation, CI check monitoring
scheduled automations for recurring agent runs
SSH/SFTP remote projects with same parallel workflow
BYO infrastructure provisioning scripts for task environments
moat_hypotheses: free Apache open-source multi-provider ADE without product account lock-in
polished worktree-first shipping loop from issues through PR/CI
local-first privacy plus optional remote SSH/BYO infra scale
YC distribution and rapid multi-OS installer coverage
setup_notes: Installers: brew install --cask emdash; GitHub Releases for dmg/msi/AppImage/deb.
Guest CLIs must be installed and authenticated outside Emdash before detection.
Telemetry is optional and can be disabled (TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false or Settings).
Single-task correctness is mostly guest-agent quality; treat Emdash as orchestration/environment.
Source monorepo requires Node >= 24 and pnpm >= 10.28 per package.json engines.

research.positioning: A free, open-source, local-first desktop Agentic Development Environment for running multiple coding agents in parallel on isolated Git worktrees, reviewing and shipping changes, and optionally targeting remote machines—without replacing provider accounts.

runtime: desktop application (Electron packaging dependency in monorepo)
guest coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Amp, and others)
Node/pnpm/Nx monorepo toolchain for development builds
backend: direct guest-agent process orchestration with optional lifecycle hooks
data: git worktrees and branches per task
optional telemetry (disabled by default path documented)
unknowns: Exact production binary version matrix and provider hook depth per CLI need hands-on notes.
Cloud BYO infra provisioning depth vs marketing examples should be verified before scoring cloud parity.

infrastructure: Runs as a local desktop ADE; local-first privacy claim that Emdash servers do not receive code/chats.
Each parallel task uses its own Git worktree and branch.
Remote projects reuse the same workflow over SSH/SFTP on user-owned machines.
Guest agents may still send code to their own providers under those providers' policies.
Optional telemetry can be disabled in settings or via environment variable.

orchestration: parallel multi-agent tasks with shared review surface
issue/ticket → agent handoff from multiple trackers
provider lifecycle hooks for status/notifications/resume when supported
workspace_isolation: separate Git worktree and branch per agent/task
local project and remote project isolation
optional provisioned environments via setup scripts
remote_mobile: SSH/SFTP remote projects (agent, key, or password auth)
no first-party mobile companion ADE documented in reviewed pages
context_memory: per-task conversation and review state in the app
prompts, skills, and MCP library for reusable agent resources
issue/ticket body as task context when launched from trackers
integrations: Linear, GitHub, Jira, GitLab, Asana, Featurebase, Monday.com, Forgejo, Plain (issue intake per README)
MCP servers synced to supported agents

install_surface: optional source build with Node 24+ and pnpm
at least one authenticated guest coding CLI
parity_risks: Provider detection and hook support vary by CLI.
Nested worktrees: ensure harness verify root is the task worktree Emdash used.
Remote SSH runs are not parity-equivalent to local desktop runs.

hypotheses: Apache-2.0 free packaging undercuts paid multi-agent cockpit subscriptions.
Issue-tracker intake plus worktree shipping loop is a complete ADE workflow without cloud lock-in.
Multi-OS installers plus large agent catalog widen adoption versus Mac-only peers.
evidence: Official site and README assert open-source ADE, worktrees, multi-provider, privacy, multi-OS installers.
package.json and LICENSE.md confirm monorepo packaging and Apache-2.0.
YC company page positions Emdash as open-source ADE for parallel coding agents.
unknowns: Sustained quality vs Orca/Conductor/Synara is unscored.
Commercial cloud offering beyond BYO infra is not established from reviewed pages.
